Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/9] descriptive knowledge of normative trajectories of mean-level change in positive and negative affect across the adolescent transition is lacking, and such research is needed in order to contextualize change in emotion regulation and state affect during this period of development, as well as to identify periods of heightened vulnerability to affective dysfunction.
